performance_source: Frozen-policy deterministic CARLA evaluations only; training windows and counterfactual rescoring excluded.

causal_limit: Before-after comparison includes 20 additional PPO updates and a reward fork. No equal-budget old-reward continuation or replicated training seeds; not reward-only causal evidence.
